title: Nurturing Indian Karela Bowl
description: A satvik-friendly, crunchy bitter gourd bowl featuring gently poached egg yolks, perfect for a sophisticated date night.
instructions: Wash and slice karela lengthwise into thin 1/2‑inch strips, then slit each strip to release bitterness.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan over medium heat, add cumin seeds and let them sputter.
Add sliced karela, turmeric, coriander powder, salt, and stir for 5 minutes until the slices soften but remain crisp.
While karela cooks, bring a pot of water to a gentle simmer and set up a bain‑marie by placing a heat‑proof bowl on top, ensuring the bowl does not touch the water.
Carefully separate the yolks from the whites, placing the yolks into the bowl of the bain‑marie.
Cover the bowl with a lid and let the yolks poach for 5 to 6 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks remain runny.
Remove the poached yolks with a slotted spoon and gently place them on top of the sautéed karela.
Drizzle the dish with lemon juice, sprinkle chopped cilantro and dried fenugreek leaves for aroma, and season with a pinch of salt if needed.
Serve the karela bowl immediately for a warm, crunchy, and comforting meal.
Optionally, add a side of plain yogurt for added satvik balance.
